_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Early Settlement and Iron Age
910.label: Event
910.description: Twa hunter-gatherer communities; Bantu migration bringing agriculture and ironworking to the Great Lakes region.

910.name: Twa Forest Communities
910.label: Event
910.description: Twa (Batwa) hunter-gatherers as earliest known inhabitants of the forested highlands.

910.name: Bantu Migration into Rwanda
910.label: Event
910.description: Bantu-speaking peoples settle the region; introduction of iron smelting, banana cultivation, and cattle-keeping.

920.name: Kingdom of Rwanda
920.label: Event
920.description: Emergence of the Kingdom of Rwanda under mwami (king) rule; development of clan structures, cattle-based social organisation, and centralised monarchy.

920.name: Origins of Mwami Monarchy
920.label: Event
920.description: Emergence of small Hutu and Tutsi kingdoms; gradual consolidation under Tutsi mwami dynasty.

920.name: Expansion of the Kingdom
920.label: Event
920.description: Rwanda kingdom expands through military conquest and cattle clientship (ubuhake); highly centralised state emerges.

930.name: Peak of Rwandan Kingdom
930.label: Event
930.description: Rwandan kingdom reaches maximum power under great mwami; military expansion; intore warrior traditions; first European contact.

930.name: Reign of Kigeli IV Rwabugiri
930.label: Event
930.description: Rwanda's most powerful mwami; military campaigns expand borders; highly centralised administration; resists early European intrusion.

930.name: First European Contact
930.label: Event
930.description: Count von Götzen becomes first European to enter Rwanda 1894; kingdom remains largely autonomous.

940.name: German and Belgian Colonial Rule
940.label: Event
940.description: German indirect rule; Belgian League of Nations mandate; racial ideology imposed on Hutu-Tutsi identities; identity cards; growing tensions.

940.name: German East Africa Period
940.label: Event
940.description: Rwanda incorporated into German East Africa; indirect rule through mwami; minimal administrative presence.

940.name: Belgian Mandate and Trusteeship
940.label: Event
940.description: Belgium seizes Rwanda in WWI; League of Nations mandate; racial theories harden Hutu-Tutsi divisions.

950.name: First and Second Hutu Republics
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence under Kayibanda; Habyarimana coup; Tutsi exile and periodic pogroms; RPF invasion from Uganda.

950.name: Kayibanda First Republic
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence 1 July 1962; Grégoire Kayibanda president; Hutu dominance; anti-Tutsi violence 1963, 1967.

950.name: Habyarimana Second Republic
950.label: Event
950.description: Juvénal Habyarimana seizes power; one-party MRND rule; northern Hutu elite; Tutsi excluded from power.

950.name: 1994 Genocide Against the Tutsi
950.label: Event
950.description: Systematic genocide kills approximately 800,000 Tutsi and moderate Hutu in 100 days; RPF victory ends the genocide.

950.name: Assassination of Habyarimana
950.label: Event
950.description: Presidential plane shot down 6 April 1994; genocide begins within hours; Interahamwe and army carry out mass killings.

950.name: The Hundred Days
950.label: Event
950.description: Approximately 800,000 Tutsi and moderate Hutu systematically murdered April–July 1994; international community fails to intervene.

960.name: Post-Genocide Reconstruction and Modern Rwanda
960.label: Event
960.description: Kagame-led reconstruction; Gacaca courts; economic transformation; regional military involvement; authoritarian governance debates.

960.name: Gacaca Community Justice Courts
960.label: Event
960.description: Community-based transitional justice courts process nearly 2 million genocide cases; reconciliation model.

960.name: Rwanda in Congo Wars
960.label: Event
960.description: Rwanda intervenes in First and Second Congo Wars; pursuit of genocide perpetrators; resource extraction controversies.
